title: PC cannot ping server in same VLAN
symptom: PC1 gets an IP but cannot reach Server1.
show_output: Server1 is on Fa0/2. Both should be VLAN 10.
expected_fault:
Switch# show vlan brief
1    default                          active    Fa0/3, Fa0/4
10   Servers                          active    Fa0/1
20   Clients                          active    Fa0/2
osi_layer: PC and Server are in different VLANs (Fa0/2 is in VLAN 20 instead of 10)
column12: Reassign Fa0/2 to VLAN 10 using 'switchport access vlan 10'.

title: Missing VLAN on switch
symptom: Users report no network access.
topology_note: PC is connected to Fa0/1 configured for VLAN 30.
show_output:
Switch# show vlan brief
1    default                          active    Fa0/2, Fa0/3
10   Servers                          active    
20   Clients                          active
expected_fault: VLAN 30 does not exist in the VLAN database.

title: VLAN interface is down
symptom: Cannot route between VLANs.
topology_note: Router is doing router-on-a-stick. VLAN 10 and 20 configured.
show_output:
Router# show ip interface brief
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0     unassigned      YES unset  up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/0.10  192.168.10.1    YES manual administratively down down
GigabitEthernet0/0.20  192.168.20.1    YES manual up                    up
expected_fault: Subinterface Gi0/0.10 is administratively down.

title: Native VLAN mismatch
symptom: CDP errors and spanning tree issues.
topology_note: Switch1 connected to Switch2 via trunk.
show_output:
Switch1# show interfaces trunk
Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Fa0/24      on           802.1q         trunking      1

Switch2# show interfaces trunk
Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Fa0/24      on           802.1q         trunking      99
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch on trunk link (1 vs 99).
expected_fix: Configure native VLAN to match on both ends.

title: Incorrect Default Gateway on PC
symptom: PC1 can ping local devices but cannot reach the internet.
expected_fault: PC is configured with the wrong default gateway.
expected_fix: Change default gateway on PC to 192.168.1.1.

title: Missing Default Gateway on Switch
symptom: Cannot manage the switch from a remote subnet.
show_output:
Switch# show run | include default-gateway
(no output)
expected_fault: Switch lacks 'ip default-gateway' configuration.

title: Gateway mismatch in DHCP pool
symptom: Clients get IP but cannot browse.
show_output:
Router# show run | section dhcp
ip dhcp pool CLIENTS
 network 172.16.0.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 172.16.1.1
expected_fault: Default router in DHCP pool is outside the subnet.
expected_fix: Change default-router in DHCP pool to 172.16.0.1.

title: DHCP Exhaustion
symptom: New PCs cannot get an IP address.
show_output:
Router# show ip dhcp binding
(Outputs 253 bindings)
Router# show ip dhcp pool
Pool CLIENTS : 
 Utilization mark (high/low)    : 100 / 0
 Subnet size (first/next)       : 0 / 0 
 Total addresses                : 254
 Leased addresses               : 253
expected_fault: DHCP pool is exhausted.
expected_fix: Expand the DHCP pool or reduce lease times.

title: Missing IP helper-address
symptom: PCs on VLAN 20 do not get DHCP addresses.
show_output:
Router# show run int vlan 20
interface Vlan20
 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0
!
expected_fault: No ip helper-address configured on the relay interface.

title: Excluded addresses conflict
symptom: Duplicate IP address warnings on network.
show_output:
Router# show run | include exclude
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.1.1 192.168.1.5
expected_fault: Static IPs 192.168.1.10-20 are not excluded and are being handed out.
expected_fix: Add 'ip dhcp excluded-address' for the static IP ranges.

title: Missing DNS Server
symptom: Users can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot open websites.
show_output:
C:\> ipconfig /all
IPv4 Address: 192.168.1.10
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.1.1
DNS Servers:
expected_fault: No DNS server configured.
expected_fix: Configure DNS server IP on the PC.

title: Wrong DNS IP in DHCP
symptom: Clients cannot resolve names.
show_output:
Router# show run | section dhcp
ip dhcp pool LAN
 network 10.10.10.0 255.255.255.0
 dns-server 10.10.11.1
expected_fault: DNS server IP is a typo
column12: Update the dns-server command in the DHCP pool.

title: Router domain-lookup disabled
symptom: Cannot ping hostnames from router.
show_output:
Router# ping google.com
Translating "google.com"...domain server (255.255.255.255)
% Unrecognized host or address, or protocol not running.
expected_fault: ip domain-lookup is disabled or no name-server configured.

title: Missing Static Route
symptom: Cannot reach branch office subnet 10.20.0.0/16.
topology_note: HQ Router connected to Branch Router.
show_output:
HQ_Router# show ip route
C 10.10.0.0/16 is directly connected
C 192.168.1.0/24 is directly connected
expected_fault: No route to 10.20.0.0/16 exists.

title: Wrong Next Hop
symptom: Traffic to internet is failing.
show_output:
Router# show ip route
S* 0.0.0.0/0 [1/0] via 198.51.100.2
expected_fault: Next hop for default route is wrong (should be 198.51.100.1).

title: OSPF Neighbor Down
symptom: Missing routes from OSPF peer.
show_output:
Router# show ip ospf neighbor
(no output)
expected_fault: OSPF adjacency is not forming.

title: Missing inter-VLAN routing
symptom: VLAN 10 cannot ping VLAN 20.
show_output:
Switch# show ip route
(empty)
expected_fault: ip routing is not enabled globally.
expected_fix: Run 'ip routing' in global configuration mode.

title: Passive Interface blocks routing
symptom: RIP routes not being advertised to neighbor.
show_output:
Router# show ip protocols
Routing Protocol is "rip"
Passive Interface(s):
  GigabitEthernet0/0
expected_fault: Interface Gi0/0 is passive

title: Implicit Deny blocking traffic
symptom: Web server is inaccessible from outside.
topology_note: Router with ACL applied inbound on WAN.
show_output:
Router# show access-lists
Extended IP access list WAN_IN
 10 permit tcp any host 203.0.113.10 eq 80
expected_fault: ACL is missing permit statement for return traffic or other ports
column12: Add required permit rules to the ACL.

title: Wrong ACL direction
symptom: Internal users cannot access the internet.
show_output:
Router# show run int gi0/1
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip access-group 100 in
expected_fault: ACL applied inbound on the LAN interface instead of outbound on WAN.
expected_fix: Apply ACL in the correct direction.

title: Standard ACL placed wrong
symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1
topology_note: but can't reach anything else either.
show_output: Standard ACL blocks PC1 from Server.
expected_fault:
Router# show access-lists
Standard IP access list 10
 10 deny 192.168.1.10
 20 permit any
osi_layer: Standard ACL applied too close to source
column13: Use Extended ACL or move Standard ACL closer to destination.

title: Missing NAT Inside/Outside
symptom: Internet access fails for internal users.
show_output:
Router# show ip nat statistics
Total active translations: 0
expected_fault: Interfaces lack 'ip nat inside' or 'ip nat outside'.
expected_fix: Configure 'ip nat inside' on LAN and 'ip nat outside' on WAN.

title: Wrong NAT Pool / ACL
symptom: Users cannot browse.
show_output:
Router# show run | include nat
ip nat inside source list 2 interface GigabitEthernet0/0 overload
Router# show access-lists
Standard IP access list 2
 10 permit 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255
expected_fault: ACL for NAT does not match the actual user subnet (e.g.
column12: Correct the ACL used for NAT.

title: Static NAT port typo
symptom: External users reach wrong internal port.
show_output:
Router# show run | include nat
ip nat inside source static tcp 192.168.1.10 8080 203.0.113.5 80
expected_fault: Traffic to port 80 is forwarded to 8080

title: SSID mismatch
symptom: Laptops cannot see the Wi-Fi network.
show_output:
AP# show dot11 associations
(empty)
expected_fault: SSID broadcast is disabled or mismatched.
expected_fix: Enable SSID broadcast or fix SSID string.

title: WPA Key mismatch
symptom: Clients try to connect but get rejected.
show_output:
AP# show logging
%DOT11-4-CCMP_REPLAY: CCMP replay error
expected_fault: Pre-shared key mismatch between client and AP.
expected_fix: Update PSK on client to match AP.

title: AP on wrong switchport VLAN
symptom: Wireless users get no IP address.
show_output:
Switch# show interfaces trunk
(no output)
expected_fault: Switchport connected to AP is an access port instead of a trunk.
expected_fix: Configure the AP switchport as a trunk.

title: Port Security Violation
symptom: PC loses connection after being swapped.
show_output:
Switch# show interfaces fa0/1 status
Port      Name               Status       Vlan       Duplex  Speed Type
Fa0/1                        err-disabled 10         auto    auto  10/100BaseTX
expected_fault: Port is in err-disabled state due to MAC violation.

title: Duplex Mismatch
symptom: Slow network performance
show_output: Switch connected to old server.
expected_fault:
Switch# show interfaces fa0/1
FastEthernet0/1 is up, line protocol is up
  Half-duplex, 100Mb/s
  ... 12345 collisions, 12 late collisions

title: Trunk allowed VLANs restrict traffic
symptom: VLAN 20 users cannot reach the router.
show_output:
Switch# show interfaces trunk
Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Gi0/1       on           802.1q         trunking      1

Port        Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1       1,10
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is missing from the allowed VLAN list on the trunk.
expected_fix: Add VLAN 20 using 'switchport trunk allowed vlan add 20'.

title: Duplicate IP
symptom: Intermittent connection drops.
show_output:
Switch# show arp
Protocol  Address          Age (min)  Hardware Addr   Type   Interface
Internet  192.168.1.10           0   0000.1111.2222  ARPA   Vlan1
Internet  192.168.1.10           0   0000.3333.4444  ARPA   Vlan1
expected_fault: Two MAC addresses hold the same IP address.
expected_fix: Change IP address of one device.

title: Wrong Subnet Mask
symptom: PC cannot ping gateway.
show_output:
C:\> ipconfig
IPv4 Address: 192.168.1.10
Subnet Mask: 255.255.0.0
expected_fault: Subnet mask is too broad (/16 instead of /24)
column12: Correct the subnet mask on the PC.
